purpose: Limit an amount or mark an action after which a state has continued.
keywords: talk about time sequence duration habits
Noun + きり; verb past form + きり
I am the only person at home today.
He went out and has not come back yet.
I have seen that film only once.
formation: Noun + きり; verb past form + きり
restrictions: With a past action, the expected following action has not occurred.
mistake: 二人きり means just two people; たきり describes what has not happened since.
